verification_notes: Prichard's exposure describes the third degree; no second independent source is recorded yet.

statement: The OT III materials contain a cosmological narrative centred on a figure named Xenu.
verification_notes: SRC-0010 and SRC-0011 are separate court files from unrelated cases and count as independent. SRC-0012 is not counted: the postings drew partly on court-filed material.

statement: Śaṅkara's commentary on the Brahmasūtra holds that śūdras are not entitled to study the Veda.
verification_notes: Based on the commentary's own text.

statement: The Mishnah forbids expounding the account of the chariot even to one student, unless the student is a sage who understands on his own.
verification_notes: Based on the Mishnah's own text.

statement: The restricted women's knowledge about Hindmarsh Island was fabricated.
verification_notes: The Royal Commission (1995) concluded it was fabricated, without evidence from the women proposing it. In 2001 von Doussa J, who heard evidence from some of them, said he was not satisfied it was fabricated or that it was not part of genuine Aboriginal tradition. The two are independent bodies that heard different evidence.
